meta.name: paid-ads-tiktok
meta.description: Audit, diagnose, and safely operate connected TikTok Ads accounts through the NotFair MCP. Use for TikTok advertising, Spark Ads, short-form video ads, campaign or ad-group analysis, spend, conversions, targeting, creative, budgets, bids, creator briefs, campaign setup, or approved TikTok Ads changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断并调整 TikTok 广告投放,管好预算、出价与素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在跑 TikTok 广告,想查花费、转化和出价哪里不对
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and adjust TikTok ad campaigns, tuning budgets, bids, and creative
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run TikTok ads and want to see where spend, conversions, and bids went wrong

howto.what: 通过 NotFair MCP 读取你的 TikTok Ads 线上数据,做投放审核与诊断;任何改动前先展示现状与风险并预览,经你批准后执行一次,再回读确认结果。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 TikTok 广告账号(花费、转化、定向等),或执行已批准的广告改动时触发。

say.text: 帮我审一下这个 TikTok 广告账号最近 30 天的花费和转化
say.note: 会先做一次线上账号读取再给结论

say.text: 诊断这个广告组 CPA 偏高的原因
say.note: 会区分实测事实与推断

say.text: 把这条广告的日预算从 100 调到 150,先给我预览
say.note: 会展示现状、风险并等你批准

howto.what_en: Reads live TikTok Ads data through the NotFair MCP to audit and diagnose campaigns; before any change it shows current values and risk, previews, applies once after your approval, then reads back to confirm.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze a TikTok Ads account (spend, conversions, targeting, etc.) or to run an approved ad change.

say_en.text: Audit spend and conversions for this TikTok Ads account over the last 30 days
say_en.note: Runs a live account read first

say_en.text: Diagnose why this ad group's CPA is high
Preview raising this ad's daily budget from 100 to 150
say_en.note: Shows current value and risk, then waits
